{{Quote|There is a prisoner in your area. Immensely powerful, hardened by decades of experimentations and then left to rot. He is known only as "Subject 13." He must be freed and made to serve the Empire.|Mohgren|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Mohgren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], Mohgren sought to free the mysterious prisoner [[Subject 13]] from deep within [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], but his expedition of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] failed to reach the prisoner. Mohgren remotely recruited other Imperials in the area to locate Subject 13, who turned out to be a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] trapped in a [[mind prison]], and Mohgren dispatched his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Suvaar]] to facilitate the prisoner's escape&mdash;although that meant Suvaar had to offer his body for Subject 13 to possess.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Mohgren is contacted via a holoterminal on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and provides Imperial players with the mission "Subject 13."<ref name="TOR" />
